title: Two Homes w/ Pool | 8BR Mesa Retreat | Sleeps 24
description:
Welcome to the ultimate Mesa group getaway - Book both homes together for the ultimate Mesa group stay! This dual-home setup sleeps up to 24 guests and offers unmatched space, privacy, and amenities. Enjoy a private pool, resort-style backyard, BBQ, pizza oven, fire pit, spacious yards, and multiple living areas across two fully remodeled homes; perfect for families, groups, events, or extended stays near Tempe, golf, dining, and major freeways. WISHLIST & BOOK NOW :)

 The space 
This dual-property listing includes two separate homes rented together for exclusive use.

HOME 1 – Large Group Home (5BR / 3BA | Sleeps 16)

Designed for entertaining and large groups with expansive indoor and outdoor spaces, a private pool, and multiple sleeping zones.

Layout:

Bedroom 1 (Top Floor): King | Sleeps 2 | 55” TV
Bedroom 2 (Top Floor): King + workspace | Sleeps 2 | 55” TV
Bedroom 3 (Top Floor): King + desk | Sleeps 2 | 50” TV
Bedroom 4 (Ground Floor): King | Sleeps 2 | 50” TV
Bedroom 5 (Ground Floor): Queen | Sleeps 2 | 45” TV

Additional Sleeping: 

Sunroom: 2 sleeper sofas + queen air mattress | Sleeps 4
Living Room: 2 sleeper sofas | Sleeps 2 | 80” TV

Highlights: 

Private swimming pool & resort-style backyard
Pool bar with TV, fridge, BBQ, pizza oven & fire pit
Multiple indoor & outdoor dining areas
Sunroom with flexible sleeping options
Fully equipped kitchen with coffee & waffle bar

HOME 2 – Modern Comfort Home (3BR / 2BA | Sleeps 8)

A stylish, bright home ideal for overflow guests, families, or those wanting extra privacy.

Layout: 

Bedroom 1: King | Sleeps 2 | 45” TV
Bedroom 2: Queen | Sleeps 2 | 45” TV
Bedroom 3: King | Sleeps 2 | 45” TV

Additional Sleeping: 

Living Room: Queen air mattress | Sleeps 2

Highlights: 

Covered patio with BBQ, hammock & seating
Spacious grassy backyard
Fully equipped kitchen & dining area
Quiet cul-de-sac location
Total Sleeping Capacity
Up to 24 guests
8 bedrooms + multiple sleeper options
5 full bathrooms (including bathtubs)

Great dining, craft breweries, boutique shopping, and a central plaza hosting year-round festivals and local markets.

 Guest access 
Guests have full, exclusive access to both homes, all indoor and outdoor spaces, backyards, and the private swimming pool. Each home has self check-in for a smooth and flexible arrival.

 Other things to note 
1. Pets allowed with additional fee & approval.

2. Homes are directly across the street for easy group coordination.

3. Ideal for large families, reunions, retreats, and extended stays.

For Home 1 - 5Br: 

Owner Presence: The property owner resides in a basement of the home when not traveling.
Privacy: The basement is separate, and guests have their own private space during their stay.

Noise & Quiet Hours: To ensure a peaceful environment for everyone, quiet hours are enforced after 10:00 PM.
amenities: Pack ’n play/Travel crib - always at the listing
